set.body:
Scope
Add Udell-style generalized observation semantics as a cohesive sibling layer over the operator core.

Acceptance criteria
- FeatureDomain, EntryLoss, ObservationPattern, ObservationWeight, FeatureEmbedding, and DecodedPrediction are precise ADTs/capabilities.
- Observed zero, missing, structurally inapplicable, censored, and weighted observations are not conflated.
- Gaussian/quadratic, Huber, logistic, Poisson, ordinal, and categorical families carry valid domain and convexity metadata.
- Entry losses remain distinct from factor penalties.
- The objective exactly sums declared losses over the declared observation mask plus row/column structural penalties.
- Missingness assumptions and prediction target are recorded without claiming unsupported MAR/MNAR inference.
- Quadratic all-observed reduction agrees with PCA-style reconstruction; analytic and domain-error tests pass on JVM and JS.
set.title: Multivar GLRM 1: typed losses, observation masks, decoders, and objective
